observer_errors: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/proc/203100/exe'

preserved_failures: run-01: both native full-size proofs and all rejection cases passed, but /proc/PID/exe disappeared before pidfd readiness. The observer now permits at most 250 ms for authoritative exit within its deadline. A real-child regression passes, missing-live-file rejection stays covered, and run-02 repeats the full GPU qualification with clean exit observation.

cpu-execution-02: a fixed pthread stack shares a coalesced VMA with unrelated owners; charging the entire VMA rejected a valid 2 MiB caller. The successor charges retained mapping growth only for the main stack and retains pthread bounds for fixed callers. All final native suites rebuild and pass.
limitations: This reserves the admitted caller and Rayon stack backing, not complete process or runtime RSS.
Callers must maintain admitted stack/signal-stack bounds and main soft limit throughout the blocking service lifetime; observed limits do not prove continuous enforcement against external mutation.
Other caller threads, driver-created stacks, cached thread storage, allocator overhead, opaque/shared driver memory and remaining phase overlaps need separate accounting.
Fixed pthread mappings can include unrelated owners; this reservation covers the fixed pthread extent, not the entire containing VMA.
Local in-process adapters depend on their enclosing runtime contract; Linux public-worker startup performs explicit validation.
Sampled memory and thread counts are observations, not upper bounds. RSS and cgroup charged memory remain separate.
Ordinary workload admission still rejects incomplete lifetime profiles.
Broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
